1b1(rgyud): @#//rgya gar skad du/shrI DA r+N+Na ba ma hA yo gi nI tan tra rA dza nA ma//bod skad du/dpal 
1b2(rgyud): mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho chen po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/oM sangs rgyas dpa' bo la phyag 'tshalo//
1b3(rgyud): bcom ldan 'das gsung gi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na//
1b4(rgyud): bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo chen po'i dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpa' bo'i sku dang 
1b5(rgyud): gsung dang thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi b+ha ga rnams su rtsen pa dang ldan par gyur to//der dpa' bo chen 
1b6(rgyud): po'i dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis//dbang po'i dra ba bdag gis mthong //
1b7(rgyud): 'khor ba dang ni nges 'byung gis//mya ngan 'das pa so sor bskyed//de'i dbus su sku chen po//bdag gi dbang po 
1b8(rgyud): yis rig go/dpa' bo rang gi rang bzhin ni//ye shes rgya mtshor mnyan par gyis//rnal 'byor ma 'khor 
2a1(rgyud): @#//lo dbus su//phag mo bdag ni 'dri ba'o//dbang po'i dra ba ci ru bshad//bdag gis gang du bshad par bya//mthong ba dang ni chen po'i sgra//bde ba za ba de bzhin ci//ting 'dzin ming ci de la ni//
2a2(rgyud): byung ba nyams par byas pa dang //'khor ba yang dag 'byung ba ni//gang du thim par 'gyur ba yin//bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i ming //ji ltar slar yang yongs su bskyed//skur brjod pa ni gsung bar mdzod//
2a3(rgyud): nyid kyi dbang pos rig pa ni//bde ba chen po bzhugs gyur pa'i//bdag gi bdag pos gsung bar mdzod//dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen pos bka' stsal pa//phag mo lha rdzas pad ma can//lha mo rtse gcig yid kyis 
2a4(rgyud): nyon//sngon du spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni//mdor bsdus pa yis bshad par bya//dbang po 'jig rten mchog chos bshad//dra ba de la yid rol pa'o//bdag gi nga rgyal tsam gyis ni//dam tshig mchog gang 
2a5(rgyud): byung ba'o//de phyir ye shes che mthong ste//thabs chen bde la bzhugs pas so//gang du dbang po rnams kyis za//de yis nga yi mid sngon song //de tshe ting nge 'dzin tsam du//thub pa skyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs//
2a6(rgyud): yang dag lhag rtogs ye shes ni//sangs rgyas rnams kyi lha dbang pos//de rnams su byung ba'i sbyor bas//mkha' 'gro mchog mang gis byas so//bde dang mi bde gnyis nyams las//slar yang 'dir ni byung 
2a7(rgyud): ba ste//sgra yi gzugs las byung zhing 'thon//dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul lo//sems gsum rnams kyi dbye ba yis//sgrub mo khyod kyis shes par gyis//'di yis rang byung bcom ldan 'das//dpa' bo 
2a8(rgyud): mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom//'byung dang 'byung ba'i dus su ni//yongs su gsal ba 'od gsal ba'o//de phyir 'jig rten 'khor bar byed//de ni 'khor bar yongs su brjod//'dir ni sgyu ma skyes de bzhin//de ni thim pa'i 
2b1(rgyud): dngos po'ang med//myang 'das gzhan pa'i rdzas yod yin//'khor ba yi ni phyi rol son//srid pa'i rtse mo gang 'dzin pa//de phyir mya ngan 'das par brjod//gzugs ni sgyu ma lta bu'i sku//de yi gnas la rnam par 'phro//
2b2(rgyud): bdag chen ye shes gzugs kyi ni//dbang pos gsal bar rig pa ste//lha dang sbyin byed la sogs pas//mi mthong mkha' la 'gro ba'i gzugs//lha khyod kyis ni gsung rnams kyi//ye shes chen po'i ros bdag 
2b3(rgyud): tshim//de ring bdag la the tshom mchis//dpa' bo rnams kyi rang bzhin ci//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa//dpa' rnams thams cad rang bzhin te//rang bzhin de rnams chos can no//'dir ni 'dod pa'i 
2b4(rgyud): dus brjod de//'dod pa sems las yongs su byung //'dod dang sems gnyis dag las ni//byung ba gzugs ni gtso bo'o//'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba//thog ma dbus mthar yang dag gnas//gang zhig 
2b5(rgyud): mtha' ma rnams kyi sems//sems de ro mnyam gyur pa'o//dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba las//mkha' 'gro de ni de phyir byung //rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdag nyid che//sa gsum po ni bsgrub par bya//gang tshe sngon du yang 
2b6(rgyud): dag byung //'gro ba'i gtso bo tshangs pa'o//gnas dang de bzhin ji ltar stong //mgon po sems can rnams grol byed//de tshe 'jig rten khams gzhan gyis//chung ngu 'dir ni bskul ba'o//gson gson byang chub 
2b7(rgyud): spros son pa'i//sems can bsgral ba'i sems med pa//sgyu ma'i rang bzhin khyod bzhugs nas//khams gsum ma lus bsgral bar mdzod//yon tan ngag 'di thos nas ni//sems can grol byed 'di ltar 
2b8(rgyud): bsgom//de bzhin gshegs pa kun rnam pa//'gro ba'i gtso bo he ru ka/dpal ni sngon du mngon brjod pas//rten la stsogs pa bskyed pa ste//glu dang rol mo dri za dang //gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams 
3a1(rgyud): @#//
3b1(rgyud): ba'o//thung ngu nyi ma'i rgyu ba yis//de bzhin du ni cha shas za//bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya//gnyis med ye shes bla na med//byang chub sems 'od chen por ni//rnal 'byor chen po nges par 'gro//stong nyid snying rje dbyer 
3b2(rgyud): med de//dngos rnams nam mkha'i me tog bzhin//sad pa na yang nyams pa ste//de gnas kun tu gnas min pa'o//rmi lam yul med las byung ba//dbang po kun las byung ba med//gnyid log pa yi stobs kyis ni//
3b3(rgyud): sa gsum po ni bza' bar bya//gnyid mthug skyes pa'i dus de ltar//sad med gnyid med rmi lam med//'das pa'i bde ba'i dus rnams su//sangs rgyas nyid kyang lag par gnas//mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems 
3b4(rgyud): dpa' ni//rdo rje mkha' 'gro mchog tu bde//las kyi yul ni bsten byas na//sum bcu rtsa gsum du ltung ngo //ma rig pas slad nges par ni//'gro ba dmyal sogs 'jigs pa che//de phyir sangs rgyas chos dge 
3b5(rgyud): 'dun//rdzu 'phrul che 'dir rjes chags bya//ji ltar bcom ldan 'das bdag po//mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi ni ming //de ni bdag la sems pas gsungs//mkha' 'gro kun la bdag mchog tu//gsang ba der ni btud 
3b6(rgyud): byas nas//phag mo lha rdzas rnal 'byor ma//gnyis med tshig gis ji ltar zhes//de bzhin yang nas yang du dris//mkha' 'gro ma'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa//phra mo'i rnam pa rtsa gsum ste//rnam par shes 
3b7(rgyud): pa gsum gyi rgyu//de phyir phra mor rig bya ste//rtsa 'byung pa ni bdag nyid che//sum bcu rtsa bdun rnal 'byor ma//re re la ni de yongs ldan//mkha' 'gro ma kun der bshad de//gzhan yang de ltar ngo mtshar che//
3b8(rgyud): ming mdor bstan pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir//de kun ji lta bzhin bshad bya//zla ba 'o ma snum pa mo//'jam ma 'dod ma kun sbyin ma//ma dang sring mo bu mo dang //sring mo'i bu mo ne mo//gnyen mo pha'i ma dang ni//zhang po yi 
4a1(rgyud): @#//yang chung ma dang //pad can dung can sna tshogs ma//glang po ma dang myos brlams ma//gzugs ma sgra ma dri ma dang //ro ma reg ma yid ma dang //chos dbyings ma dang tshogs can ma//gnyis ma le 
4a2(rgyud): lo ma gzhan gnon//rlom pa mo dang sgeg mo dang //bzang zhal ma dang drag mo ma//'thung ma zam 'jigs pa mo//ha ha sgrogs ma dur khrod ma//bcom ldan dgyes mar rtag tu bshad//sum bcu rtsa bdun rnal 
4a3(rgyud): 'byor ma//las kyi cho ga blangs pa yis//gzhan gyi ming yang shes par bya//gang zhig gang gir mngon brjod pa'i//rtsa de 'dir ni brjod pa'o//de rnams sems dpa' bde rang bzhin//mthar gyur mchog tu 
4a4(rgyud): zhi ba'o//rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos po yang //mchog tu zag med rnal 'byor ldan//mdog dang phyag sogs rnam pa ru//srid pa'i 'khor lor yang dag byung //gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs 'dir//pul+li ra sogs 
4a5(rgyud): dbus su'o//gang zhig gang gi lha'i bdag po//de ni de dang nges rgyas gdab//nyid dang bdag tu rtsen gyur pas//bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan//'di yis rang byung bcom ldan 'das//gcig pu de bzhin dang po'i 
4a6(rgyud): lha//mkha' 'gro ma kun bde ster ba'i//bcom ldan rdo rjes 'di gsungs so//nam mkha' thog ma tha ma med//gang 'drar mchog tu 'du shes pa//de 'drar bdag ni rig pa ste//snang med par yang yongs su gsal//
4a7(rgyud): der ni 'byung ba'ang yod min te//'jig rten pa yi tha snyad mchog/ji ltar mkha' las me byung ba//bla med me 'dar de bzhin no//ro bro pa ni gcig dngos la//de yi nang na dangs mang po//gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin 
4a8(rgyud): 'dis//thams cad ro ste ro'i khyab bdag/pho nya rnams kyi bdag po yis//sa gsum pa ni mchog tu za//thabs dang shes rab snying rje che//lha yi bdag po gzhan med do//'dod chags ma yin chags bral min//
4b1(rgyud): dbu ma yang ni mi dmigs so//de ltar rtag shes rnal 'byor pas//'dod bya kun la long spyod bya//rtag tu nang du gyur byas nas//kha dog rnams ni zhal las byung //rtag tu lus kyis sbyin pa ste//sems las byung 
4b2(rgyud): ba spang bar bya//de ltar 'dod chags sgyu mtha' la//rol pa mchog gi go 'phang ngo //'dod chags bral ba dga' ba gsum//spangs pa dbu ma zag pa med//gzung bar bya ba min pa ste//dngos po'i rang bzhin 'dod 
4b3(rgyud): chags min//bral ba'i dga' ba nyams pa ste//de la'ang dga' bar mi bya'o//de gnyis dbus na gnas pa yis//chos de la yang dga' dmigs med//dbye ba med pa yi ni chos//rdo rje la ni dga' bar gyis//lha yi 
4b4(rgyud): rnam pa'i rnal 'byor bdag/skad cig mngon sum byed pa'o//lugs ma la sogs rnal 'byor gyis//rnam par byas pa'i dbyibs su 'gyur//stong nyid rang bzhin gzugs rnal 'byor//rang byin brlab pa'i mtshan nyid 
4b5(rgyud): do//bdag byin brlab dang bral rnal 'byor//sbum logs dum bu bzhin shes bya//'di 'dra'i mtshan nyid mchog gyur pa//skye bo phyugs rnams kyis mi shes//de phyir sgyu 'phrul 'di bsgoms na//byang chub bla na med 
4b6(rgyud): pa thob//skye ba 'di la glen pa nyid//shes rab snyan dngags skyes bur 'gyur//'di 'dra'i yon tan tshogs ldan pas//rmi lam dang ni mnyam par ltos//rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du//'gro ste de phyir 'jig 
4b7(rgyud): rten pa'o//mngon sum rang nyid sngags kyi sku//'khor lo gsum rnams nyis 'gyur ro//gcig la 'khor lo gsum bshad de//gnyis pa nyis 'gyur du ni 'dod//'khor lo gsum po thabs shes rab//snyoms 
4b8(rgyud): par 'jug par 'chad pa'o//de ni nyis 'gyur shes bya ste//'khor lo nyis 'gyur des bshad do//khams gsum gyi ni gnas chen po//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa'o//dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba//rdo rje 
5a1(rgyud): sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog/de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' dbang che//bcom ldan rdo rjes 'di gsungs so//chos dang chos min gang du nub//byang chub der ni sems gzung gis//grub pa lha 
5a2(rgyud): dang lha ma yin//dbang po dang ni yul dang ni//khams dang skye mched thams cad ni//skye ba dang ni 'gag pa ste//rmongs pa 'ching zhing mkhas pa ni//yongs su shes pas grol ba'o//sems 'di rang nyid mngon sum du//
5a3(rgyud): khams gsum du ni rnam par gnas//bdag dang mchog khyod gnyis med las//tshogs pa'i gtso bo byung ba'o//spyod lam la sogs bye brag chos//mdo sde rnam shes dbu ma pa//mos pa'i sems can rnams bshad 
5a4(rgyud): de//bden pa ma yin rdzun pa min//phyag ni bcu gnyis dang ldan te//de bzhin zhal ni bzhi pa'o//kha dog nam mkha' sngon po la//spyan gsum brkyang bskum ldan pa ste//'phrog byed dkar mo mnyam par mnan//gzhan ni 'bum tsho 
5a5(rgyud): stong phrag gi/gang dang gang gi rgyud kyi ni//phyi dang gsang ba nang bdag nyid//de dang de yi gzugs nges par//lha ni he ru ka'i bdag nyid//rgyud dang rgyud kyi nang mchog tu//dbye ba mos pa'i dbang gis te//ming ni de 'drar shes 
5a6(rgyud): par bya//'on kyang he ru ka bsres pa'o//kha dog de dang 'drar shes bya//bzhugs tshul he ru ka'i rnam pa//sa ni bcu gnyis rnams kyi rgyu//de yis he ru ka dang 'dra//rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs//dpa' bo thams 
5a7(rgyud): cad mnyam sbyor ba//rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog/bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so//dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa ste 'di ni le'u 
5a8(rgyud): dang po'o////phag mo lha rdzas rnal 'byor mas//slar yang rdo rje mchod byas te//bcom ldan bdag pos bstan par mdzod//phag mo ci yis yongs su byung //bskyed pa gang gis bskyed pa yin//rang bzhin 
5b1(rgyud): ji ltar du ni 'dod//bdag byung ba yi rgyu mtshan ci//'dir ni dgos pa ji ltar yin//dbang po dang ni yul thams cad//lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du rab zhugs//spyi bo'i rdo rje gur du ni//steng du kha bltas rlung 'bab bo//'dod 
5b2(rgyud): chags nyi ma'i dbus su ni//skad cig gis ni sprul thim gyur//der skyes pa yi phag mo ni//b+ha ga ling ga yid las byung //bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin khams//de rnams las ni sngon du skyes//rang bzhin bdag med 
5b3(rgyud): gcig pu ste//mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no//rgyu mtshan skye bo sgrol ba dang //snying rje'i gzugs rang bzhin du byung //'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rig ste//phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sgrub pa'o//khyod ni lha mo'i bdag 
5b4(rgyud): po ste//kun tu spyod pa mang spyod pa'o//sngags kyi phreng ba brje byas nas//a yig la sogs de'i khyab bdag/yang na phag mo'i rtsa ba dang //go cha'i sngags rnams kyis ldan te//yi ge re re'i sngags kyi ni//spyod pa 
5b5(rgyud): sdom par son pa'o//rnal 'byor ma mchog skye ba ni//rtsa yi mchog gi grong du ste//stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi//dbus ma a ba d+hU ti'o//dbu ma 'di ltar thams cad kyi//khyab byed du ni rnam par gnas//de 
5b6(rgyud): phyir phag mo gtso mo yi//go 'phang mchog bzhin shes par bya//rdo rje la sogs ming thog mar//a rdo rje dang ka rdo rje//sngags mthar de la sogs pa ste//yang na so so tha dad du'o//gang gi dus su sngags zlos pa//
5b7(rgyud): de dus rnams su rnal 'byor ldan//lte ba'i spyi bo snying gyen du//'di ltar 'gro dang 'ong ba med//dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gtso mo//de ni bdag nyid rnam par 'phro//rang gi 'khor ldan rnal 'byor ma//zhing dang zhing rnams 
5b8(rgyud): su ni 'gro//lha mo khyod ni bdag po ste//nga dang lhan cig kha sbyor ro//dus dang dus ni ma yin par//nam mkha'i bu ga'i nang 'dug nas//de bzhin skye gnas lam 'thon nas//'chi ba med pa'i sa bon 'dzag/der ni 
6a1(rgyud): @#//'pho med ye shes bya//hig phyed yi ges bsgom bya ste//mi mo skyes bu'i dus su yang //mchog tu zag med mngon par bya//de byung ba yi rig ma che//bsgom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bri'o//thog mar rnam 
6a2(rgyud): snang mgon po ste//ri mo sum skor lte 'og gnas//langs nas mgrin pa'i bar du 'gro//sa gsum sgron ma lta bur son//gzhan pa'i sngags ni sa mtha' 'dra//de las zla 'bab g.yon nas so//sngags 'di thig 
6a3(rgyud): les brgyan pa ste//sngags ni rnal 'byor ma bskyed pa'o//slar yang sa bon gnyis pa brjod//g.yas pa nyi ma bskyed pa ste//logs su gnyis phye mgor thig le//ya sde'i mtha' yi sa bon ni//byang chub sems chen 
6a4(rgyud): 'bab lam mo//'di ni phag mo'i sa bon yin//A yi yi ges mthar rgyan pa//bcu drug zla phyed nyi mas brgyan//ya sde'i dang po'i sa bon ni//sbyor bas sa gsum rlung yon tan//dbyangs kyi bcu gsum pas rgyas 
6a5(rgyud): gdab//dkar po'i phyogs kyi mgo bor rgyan//thig le dang ni bcas pa 'bar//dga' ba bzhi po dag pa'o//ba'i sde'i mtha' ma bde ba'i gzugs//o yi yi ge zhon ldan pa//mgo bor zla phyed nyi mas mnan//sa yi 
6a6(rgyud): pha rol gzhom med pas//nyi ma yi ni gdan la gnas//dbyangs kyi bzhi pa rna drung bzung //mgo bor zla phyed thig les brgyan//'dod chags mtha' yi rang bzhin no//ye shes sa bon nyis 'gyur dbye//spro ba dang ni 
6a7(rgyud): bsdu bas skyes//'og dang steng du gnas pa yi//mgon po longs spyod rdzogs 'dzin pa//snying kha dang ni chus skyes su//don gyi cho ga yongs rdzogs pa'o//yongs su skrag byed mas bon//ba mtha'i yi ge gzung nas 
6a8(rgyud): ni//slar yang de bzhin brjod par bya//dbu rgyan 'bar ba 'dzin grong gi/bu gar gtum mo spor ba'o//byang chub sems kyis sa gsum 'gengs//de ltar bshad pa'i sngags gang ni//rim pas yi ge rnams mi mthun//rnal 
6b1(rgyud): 'byor ma yi ming ldan par//las dus de ltar rtogs par bya//re re'i che ba'i bdag nyid ni//yi ge yi ni grangs kyis so//bdag nyid chen po rnam par 'phro//byang chub cha shas cha rgyu'o//thog mar rnam snang phyag 'tshal ba//chos 
6b2(rgyud): kyi dbyings ni bya ba'i gzugs//ta sde'i lnga ba'i yi ge ni//lnga pa yi ni sde tshan no//rnal 'byor ma gzugs nam mkhar rten//ba mtha'i sa bon o dbyangs ldan//gti mug 'joms par byed ma ste//rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs 
6b3(rgyud): spro ba'o//de yi bzhi pa'i sa bon ni//sa gsum du ni khyab pa yi//rnal 'byor ma ni spro ba'o//thog ma'i sde yi gsum pa ste//'gro ba drug po nyams byed pa'i//mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor lo spro//ya sde'i mtha' ma'i sa bon ni//
6b4(rgyud): byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin no//lnga pa'i sde yi thog ma ste//de bzhin nyid kyi sa bon te//i yi dbyangs kyis mgo la reg/chu yi yi ge yongs bsags pa//thams cad byed pa'i rang bzhin no//rtsa sde'i dbus gnas 
6b5(rgyud): bzung nas ni//nyi ma'i yi ni gdan ldan pa//las kyi dus su khyad par ldan//phag mo yi ni sa bon ni//a yi yi ge rna bar reg/sa gsum ye shes rang bzhin mnyam//me yi sa bon dbyangs gnyis ldan//'khor 
6b6(rgyud): ba'i las kyi rang bzhin no//sa mtha' mgo la i dbyangs reg/rtag tu tshangs pa'i rang bzhin blta//dbyangs kyi gnyis pa bzung nas ni//de ltar mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs//sems can sgrol bar byed pa'o//ya yig gnas 
6b7(rgyud): pa ra dang ldan//slar yang I yi dbyangs sbyar ro//khams gsum rnal 'byor ma spro'o//drug pa'i sde yi dang po ni//rnal 'byor ma sngags kun rang bzhin//ra gnas pa ni a dbyangs ldan//sdang ba'i sems can gsod 
6b8(rgyud): byed 'gyur//dza yi yi ge yongs bzung ste//i yi dbyangs dang yang dag ldan//sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yongs ldan pa'o//so yi sa bon rna ba la//i yi dbyangs kyis reg pas dbye//klu yi sngags ni sbyar byas ste//tai yi ge 
7a1(rgyud): sa gsum kun//ye shes kyi ni khyad par sngags//la yi yi ge o dang ldan//'jig rten rnams kyi rten yin te//byang chub byed pa'i chos yin no//thog ma'i ka ni ya stan ldan//'chi dang lhan skyes dbye 
7a2(rgyud): ba med//pa yi sde yi mtha' ma la//a yi yi ge'i dbyangs sbyar bya//sa gsum gyi ni ma rang bzhin//ta yig e yi yi ges brgyan//bde ba 'dzin par byed pa'o//slar yang ma sde'i mtha' ma ste//tshad med pa yi 
7a3(rgyud): lhan skyes kyi//dbus na bzhugs pa'i rang bzhin no//sa yi mtha' ma A dang ldan//rdor sems ye shes gzhom med pa'o//ya'i sde'i mtha' ma i dbyangs ldan//mi shes rang bzhin 'joms byed pa'o//t+ye sngags 
7a4(rgyud): chos dbyings rang bzhin te//thams cad rang bzhin du khyab pa'o//bu ga rnams nas 'dzag pa sa//'bab pa'i sa bon nyi ma ldan//chu srin dbang po yi ni sngags//ba sde bzhi pa'i sa bon ni//U dbyangs stan dang ldan 
7a5(rgyud): pa ste//'khor ba'i 'jigs pa nyams byed pa'o//ta yi sngags kyis dgra nyams byed//slar yang pa'i sde'i bzhi pa ni//sgra chen po ni sgrogs pa'o//rlung gi sa bon A yig reg/sngags ni nor bur 'bab bzhin pa'o//
7a6(rgyud): chu yi sa bon rnar gzung ba//sgyu ma yi ni rang bzhin no//sa yi pha rol e yig ldan//sa gsum gyi ni 'khrul 'joms rgyu//pa sde'i mtha' ma rkang rang bzhin//sa yi pha rol A dang ldan//ngo mtshar tshe ba yi ni
